info.title: Crb
info.author: Enrique Somolinos
info.details: C.R.B. (Cuerpo Rompe Bolas) is a fan-made Nintendo Switch port of a 1993 Spanish MS-DOS shareware game by Kronos. A classic Breakout/Arkanoid-style clone, it has you steering a paddle to bounce a ball, smash rows of blocks, and grab power-ups along the way. This homebrew port was built through full reverse engineering of the original DOS binary and graphics assets, bringing a piece of forgotten Spanish shareware history back to life on modern hardware
